title: TapList catalog
description: The manifest the app loads first: a list of available festival datasets and which one is the default. See TapList docs/data-model.md §1 for the prose spec.

version.description: Catalog schema version. v1 sets this to 1. Future shape changes bump it and the app may migrate or refuse older catalogs.

datasets.description: Available festival datasets. The app picks one via: the ?festivalId= query param, else the entry with default:true, else the first entry. Entries missing required fields (id, name, url) are dropped at load time with a warning.

id.description: Stable dataset identifier. Should match the `id` inside the referenced dataset; it's the localStorage namespace key for user data, so it MUST remain stable across updates of the same festival (e.g. daily WBF 2026 updates all share id: "wbf-2026"). Slug-safe: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens — no leading/trailing/double hyphens.

name.description: Human-readable festival name shown in the catalog/picker.

url.description: Where to fetch this entry's dataset JSON. Absolute (https://…) is used as-is; root-relative (/data/wbf-2026.json) is re-anchored at the data base URL.

dates.description: Festival run dates. Both bounds are required when present.

status.description: Lifecycle hint for the UI. Any other value is ignored by the runtime.

default.description: Marks the entry the app loads when no festival is otherwise selected. At most one entry should set this; if several do, the app uses the first.
